## Overview

In the previous script (`4_PCA_featureDimensions`), we used PCA to re-structure multidimensional kinematic space into fewer components. PCA is **unsupervised** which means that it does not know which datapoints belong to which group.

In this script, we fit **one model per component with neutral cell-means coding** (`0 + groupID`)
and pull every comparison of interest **after the fit with `emmeans`**. 

The main comparisons include (all in SD units, net of speaker & item):

- **gesture vs native sign** — `conventionalization`, and more broadly, `gesture_vs_all_signers`.
- **learner1 – learner2 – signer progression** — mainly mean(L1, L2) vs native signers, additionaly also `naive_vs_beginner` (L1 vs L2, within-subject), `beginner_vs_native` (L2 vs Sign), and mean(L1)

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
	echo = TRUE,
	message = FALSE,
	warning = FALSE,
	cache = TRUE
)
library(tidyverse)
library(brms)
library(tidybayes)
library(bayesplot)
library(emmeans)
library(patchwork)
library(posterior)
library(gt)
options(mc.cores = parallel::detectCores())
dir.create("models", showWarnings = FALSE)
```


## 1. Config & helpers

```{r config}
group_levels <- c("Gesture", "Learner_1", "Learner_2", "Sign")

# ---- comparisons: weights in group_levels order (Gesture, Learner_1, Learner_2, Sign) ----
# fractional weights => each estimate is a directly interpretable mean difference in SD units.
comparisons <- list(
  # "gesture vs sign"
  gesture_vs_all_signers = c( -1, 1/3, 1/3, 1/3),  # Gesture - mean(L1, L2, Sign)
  conventionalization   = c( -1,    0,    0,   1),   # Gesture - Sign  (narrow reading)
  # "learner1 - learner2 - signer" progression
  naive_vs_beginner   = c( 0,    -1,   1,    0),   # L1 - L2  (within-subject)
  acquisition = c(0, -1/2, -1/2, 1),
  beginner_vs_native  = c( 0,    0,    -1,   1)   # L2 - Sign 
)

pr <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 1),   class = "b"),      # group means (cell-means coding)
  prior(exponential(1), class = "sd"),
  prior(exponential(1), class = "sigma")
)
```

```{r helpers}

# read one domain's score file, prefix component columns with the domain ---
read_scores <- function(basis, domain) {
  suf  <- switch(basis, varimax = "_varimax", signonly = "_signonly", "")
  path <- file.path("Datasets", sprintf("pca_scores_%s%s.csv", domain, suf))
  if (!file.exists(path)) return(NULL)
  read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    rename_with(~ paste0(domain, "_", .x), matches("^(PC|RC)[0-9]+$"))
}

# build the modelling frame for a basis: merge all/gross/fine, harmonize concepts, factor, z-score 
build_d <- function(basis) {
  blocks <- map(c("all", "gross", "fine"), ~ read_scores(basis, .x))
  if (any(map_lgl(blocks, is.null))) return(NULL)   # a domain file missing -> skip basis
  names(blocks) <- c("all", "gross", "fine")

  comp_cols <- unlist(map(names(blocks), function(dm)
    grep(sprintf("^%s_(PC|RC)[0-9]+$", dm), names(blocks[[dm]]), value = TRUE)))

  key <- c("participant", "groupID", "concept")
  d <- reduce(blocks, full_join, by = key)

  # harmonize concept labels: native-signer English glosses -> German labels 
  # (done after the join, because the all/gross/fine score files share the original labels)
  concept_map <- read_csv(file.path("Datasets", "concept_map.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
  n_before <- n_distinct(d$concept)
  d <- d %>%
    left_join(select(concept_map, concept, concept_id), by = "concept") %>%
    mutate(concept = coalesce(concept_id, concept)) %>%
    select(-concept_id)
  message("[", basis, "] concepts: ", n_before, " -> ", n_distinct(d$concept),
          " after harmonization")

  d <- d %>%
    mutate(groupID     = factor(groupID, levels = group_levels),
           participant = factor(participant),
           concept     = factor(concept)) %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(comp_cols), ~ as.numeric(scale(.)), .names = "{.col}_z"))

  # NA report from the full joins (tokens not shared across all/gross/fine)
  na_rows <- d %>% summarise(across(all_of(comp_cols), ~ sum(is.na(.)))) %>%
    pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "component", values_to = "n_NA") %>%
    filter(n_NA > 0)
  if (nrow(na_rows)) { message("NA scores after join (", basis, "):"); print(na_rows) }

  stopifnot(all(levels(d$groupID) == group_levels))
  list(d = d, comp_cols = comp_cols)
}

# fit gaussian model for one component, cached per basis+component
fit_component <- function(comp, d, basis) {
  form <- bf(as.formula(paste0(comp, "_z ~ 0 + groupID + (1|participant) + (1|concept)")))
  brm(form, data = d, prior = pr, family = gaussian(),
      chains = 4, iter = 8000, warmup = 4000, seed = 1,
      control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95),
      file = file.path("models", paste0("brm_", basis, "_", comp)),
      file_refit = "on_change")
}

# extract all comparisons for one fit via emmeans (population-level: re_formula = NA)
extract_comparisons <- function(fit, comp, basis) {
  emm <- emmeans(fit, ~ groupID, re_formula = NA)     # 4 marginal means, net of RE
  w   <- if (basis == "signonly") comparisons_sign else comparisons   # 3- vs 4-group weights
  con <- contrast(emm, method = w)                    # weights positional in group order
  gather_emmeans_draws(con) %>%
    group_by(contrast) %>%
    summarise(estimate = median(.value),
              .lower   = quantile(.value, 0.025),
              .upper   = quantile(.value, 0.975),
              pd       = max(mean(.value > 0), mean(.value < 0)),
              .groups  = "drop") %>%
    mutate(component = comp,
           basis     = basis,
           domain    = str_extract(comp, "^(all|gross|fine)"),
           credible  = sign(.lower) == sign(.upper))
}

# convergence diagnostics for one fit 
diagnose <- function(fit) {
  np  <- brms::nuts_params(fit)
  drw <- as_draws_df(fit)
  ess <- summarise_draws(drw, "ess_bulk", "ess_tail")
  tibble(max_rhat     = max(brms::rhat(fit), na.rm = TRUE),
         min_ess_bulk = min(ess$ess_bulk, na.rm = TRUE),
         min_ess_tail = min(ess$ess_tail, na.rm = TRUE),
         n_divergent  = sum(np$Value[np$Parameter == "divergent__"]))
}

# read + tidy loadings for a basis (PC or RC id column -> prefixed `component`) 
read_loadings <- function(basis, domain) {
  suf  <- switch(basis, varimax = "_varimax", signonly = "_signonly", "")
  path <- file.path("Datasets", sprintf("loadings_%s%s.csv", domain, suf))
  if (!file.exists(path)) return(NULL)
  x  <- read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  id <- if (basis == "varimax") "RC" else "PC"
  if (!"sig_loading" %in% names(x) && "CI_above_null_after" %in% names(x))
    x <- rename(x, sig_loading = CI_above_null_after)     # tolerate the older column name
  x %>%
    rename(comp_id = all_of(id)) %>%
    mutate(comp_id   = as.character(comp_id),
           comp_id   = if_else(str_detect(comp_id, "^[0-9]+$"), paste0(id, comp_id), comp_id),
           component = paste0(domain, "_", comp_id),
           basis     = basis)
}
```

## 2. Modeling gesture vs learner vs native

First, check the number of items per participant per group

```{r}

tokens <- read_csv(file.path("Datasets", "pca_scores_all.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

# per participant: number of tokens and distinct concepts
per_participant <- tokens %>%
  count(groupID, participant, name = "n_tokens") %>%
  left_join(tokens %>% distinct(groupID, participant, concept) %>%
              count(groupID, participant, name = "n_concepts"),
            by = c("groupID", "participant")) %>%
  arrange(groupID, participant)

per_participant %>% print(n = Inf)

# per group summary
per_participant %>%
  group_by(groupID) %>%
  summarise(n_participants = n(),
            tokens_total   = sum(n_tokens),
            tokens_min     = min(n_tokens),
            tokens_median  = median(n_tokens),
            tokens_max     = max(n_tokens),
            .groups = "drop")
```

Here we define the functions that will allow us to run the models in a loop, or load them if already saved

```{r run-basis}
run_basis <- function(basis) {
  bd <- build_d(basis)
  if (is.null(bd)) { message("Skipping basis '", basis, "': score files missing."); return(NULL) }
  d <- bd$d; comp_cols <- bd$comp_cols
  message("[", basis, "] modelling: ", paste(comp_cols, collapse = ", "))

  fits <- setNames(lapply(comp_cols, fit_component, d = d, basis = basis), comp_cols)

  list(
    basis     = basis,
    d         = d,
    fits      = fits,
    comp_cols = comp_cols,
    coefs     = map_dfr(comp_cols, ~ extract_comparisons(fits[[.x]], .x, basis)),
    converge  = imap_dfr(fits, ~ mutate(diagnose(.x), component = .y, basis = basis)),
    n_part    = d %>% distinct(groupID, participant) %>% count(groupID, name = "n_participants")
  )
}

load_or_run <- function(basis, cache_dir = "models", refit = FALSE) {
  f <- file.path(cache_dir, paste0("run_", basis, ".rds"))
  if (!refit && file.exists(f)) {
    message("[", basis, "] loading cached run")
    return(readRDS(f))
  }
  res <- run_basis(basis)
  if (!is.null(res)) {
    dir.create(cache_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
    tmp <- tempfile(tmpdir = cache_dir, fileext = ".rds.part")
    ok <- tryCatch({
      saveRDS(res, tmp, compress = "xz")   # smaller files; use FALSE if speed matters more
      file.rename(tmp, f)
    }, error = function(e) {
      unlink(tmp)
      warning("[", basis, "] caching failed: ", conditionMessage(e))
      FALSE
    })
  }
  res
}

```


Now we can run/load the models
```{r}

res_pca     <- load_or_run("pca")
runs   <- compact(list(res_pca))
coefs  <- map_dfr(runs, "coefs")
conv   <- map_dfr(runs, "converge")

```


### Convergence (all models)

```{r converge-table}
conv %>%
  mutate(flag = max_rhat > 1.01 | min_ess_bulk < 400 | n_divergent > 0) %>%
  arrange(desc(flag), desc(max_rhat)) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 3)))
```

No model has been flagged as worth attention in terms of convergence

### Comparison estimates per component

```{r coef-table}
coefs %>%
  mutate(across(c(estimate, .lower, .upper, pd), ~ round(.x, 2))) %>%
  arrange(basis, domain, component, contrast)
```

`estimate` is a mean difference in SD units; `pd` is the posterior probability of direction;
`credible` = 95% CrI excludes 0. 


### Domain × comparison: which dimension carries which comparison

```{r}

lvl <- c("gesture_vs_all_signers", "conventionalization", "naive_vs_beginner",
         "beginner_vs_native", "acquisition")
lab <- c(conventionalization = "Conventionalization", gesture_vs_all_signers = "Gesture vs All Signers",
         naive_vs_beginner   = "Naive vs Beginner",   beginner_vs_native = "Beginner vs Native",
         learner_vs_native = "Acquisition")
pal <- c(`credible ↑` = "#D1495B", `credible ↓` = "#3A7CA5", `not credible` = "#C9CCD1")

plot_df <- coefs %>%
  filter(basis == "pca") %>%
  mutate(idx      = as.integer(str_extract(component, "[0-9]+$")),
         pc       = fct_reorder(str_remove(component, "^(all|gross|fine)_"), idx, .desc = TRUE),
         domain   = factor(domain, c("all", "gross", "fine"), c("ALL", "GROSS", "FINE")),
         contrast = factor(contrast, levels = lvl),
         status   = factor(case_when(!credible ~ "not credible",
                                     estimate > 0 ~ "credible ↑",
                                     TRUE ~ "credible ↓"),
                           levels = names(pal)))

ggplot(plot_df, aes(estimate, pc)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey70", linewidth = .4, linetype = "22") +
  geom_linerange(aes(xmin = .lower, xmax = .upper, colour = status,
                     linewidth = credible, alpha = credible), lineend = "round") +
  geom_point(aes(fill = status, size = credible, alpha = credible),
             shape = 21, colour = "white", stroke = 1) +
  facet_grid(domain ~ contrast, labeller = labeller(contrast = lab)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = pal, guide = "none") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal, name = NULL,
                    guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3.4, alpha = 1))) +
  scale_linewidth_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 1.1, `FALSE` = .6), guide = "none") +
  scale_size_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 2.7, `FALSE` = 1.8), guide = "none") +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 1, `FALSE` = .5), guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "effect (SD units, net of speaker)", y = NULL,
       title = "Group comparisons across kinematic dimensions",
       subtitle = "Unrotated PCA · point = posterior median, line = 95% CrI") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y  = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor    = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x  = element_line(colour = "grey93", linewidth = .5),
    panel.spacing.x     = unit(10, "pt"),
    panel.spacing.y     = unit(14, "pt"),
    strip.text.x        = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9.5, colour = "grey15"),
    strip.text.y        = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9.5, colour = "grey45", angle = -90),
    axis.text.y         = element_text(size = 9),
    axis.ticks          = element_blank(),
    plot.title          = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15),
    plot.subtitle       = element_text(colour = "grey55", size = 10, margin = margin(b = 10)),
    plot.title.position  = "plot",
    legend.position     = "top",
    legend.justification = "right"
  )

```
Make it more focused for the paper

```{r}

# component names shown on the y axis; edit to your final naming
pc_names <- c(PC1 = "Vigour", PC2 = "Handshape", PC3 = "Tempo",
              PC4 = "Smoothness", PC5 = "Spectral")

plot_all <- plot_df %>%
  filter(domain == "ALL") %>%
  mutate(pc_lab = paste0(coalesce(pc_names[as.character(pc)], as.character(pc)),
                         " (", pc, ")"),
         pc_lab = fct_reorder(pc_lab, idx, .desc = TRUE))

# one shared x range so effect sizes are comparable across all five panels
x_lim <- range(c(plot_all$.lower, plot_all$.upper), na.rm = TRUE)
x_lim <- c(floor(x_lim[1] * 2) / 2, ceiling(x_lim[2] * 2) / 2)

theme_fp <- theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "grey93", linewidth = .5),
    strip.text         = element_text(face = "bold", colour = "grey15", hjust = 0),
    axis.text.y        = element_text(size = 9),
    axis.ticks         = element_blank()
  )

contrast_panel <- function(ctr, big = TRUE, show_y = TRUE, x_title = NULL) {
  k <- if (big) 1 else .8   # shrink points/lines in the second row
  ggplot(filter(plot_all, contrast == ctr), aes(estimate, pc_lab)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey70", linewidth = .4, linetype = "22") +
    geom_linerange(aes(xmin = .lower, xmax = .upper, colour = status,
                       linewidth = credible, alpha = credible), lineend = "round") +
    geom_point(aes(fill = status, size = credible, alpha = credible),
               shape = 21, colour = "white", stroke = 1) +
    facet_wrap(~ contrast, labeller = labeller(contrast = lab)) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = pal, limits = names(pal), drop = FALSE, guide = "none") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = pal, limits = names(pal), drop = FALSE, name = NULL,
                      guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3.4, alpha = 1))) +
    scale_linewidth_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 1.3, `FALSE` = .7) * k, guide = "none") +
    scale_size_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 3.2, `FALSE` = 2.1) * k, guide = "none") +
    scale_alpha_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 1, `FALSE` = .5), guide = "none") +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = x_lim) +
    labs(x = x_title, y = NULL) +
    theme_fp +
    theme(strip.text = element_text(size = if (big) 12 else 9.5)) +
    if (!show_y) theme(axis.text.y = element_blank()) else NULL
}

lvl <- c("conventionalization", "acquisition", "gesture_vs_all_signers",
         "naive_vs_beginner", "beginner_vs_native")
lab <- c(conventionalization     = "Conventionalization",
         acquisition             = "Acquisition",
         gesture_vs_all_signers  = "Gesture vs All signers",
```

### Model checks

```{r pp-loo, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 4}
# posterior predictive + LOO for every fit; collect Pareto-k warnings
loo_tab <- imap_dfr(runs, function(run, i) {
  imap_dfr(run$fits, function(fit, comp) {
    l <- loo(fit)
    tibble(basis = run$basis, component = comp,
           elpd_loo   = l$estimates["elpd_loo", "Estimate"],
           p_loo      = l$estimates["p_loo", "Estimate"],
           n_pareto_k_gt_0.7 = sum(l$diagnostics$pareto_k > 0.7))
  })
})
loo_tab %>% arrange(desc(n_pareto_k_gt_0.7)) %>% mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(.x, 1)))

pp_check(res_pca$fits[[ res_pca$comp_cols[1] ]], ndraws = 100)
```

### Interpretation — which features drive each credible comparison

Join credible comparisons to the (basis-matched) significant loadings. Direction: a positive
comparison estimate on a positively-loading feature => the first group shows *more* of it.

```{r interpretation}

loadings <- map_dfr(
  c("pca"),
  function(b) map_dfr(c("all", "gross", "fine"), ~ read_loadings(b, .x))
)

interpretation <- coefs %>%
  filter(credible) %>%
  select(basis, component, contrast, effect = estimate) %>%
  inner_join(loadings, by = c("basis", "component")) %>%
  filter(sig_loading) %>%
  mutate(
    # signed loading (works whether obs_index is stored signed or unsigned)
    loading  = abs(obs_index) * loading_sign,
    # split leading category from the measure name
    category = if_else(str_detect(variable, "^[^_]+__[^_]+__"),
                       str_extract(variable, "^[^_]+__[^_]+"),   # e.g. "gross__rwrist"
                       NA_character_),
    measure  = if_else(str_detect(variable, "^[^_]+__[^_]+__"),
                       str_remove(variable, "^[^_]+__[^_]+__"),  # e.g. "speed_mean"
                       variable),
    moves    = if_else(sign(effect) == sign(loading), "↑ more", "↓ less")
  ) %>%
  arrange(basis, contrast, component, category, desc(abs(loading))) %>%
  relocate(category, measure, loading, .after = component)

interpretation
```

### Speaker- and concept-level plots (all groups)

```{r speaker-helpers, cache = FALSE}

model_id  <- "GtST"                      # native signer in the stimulus video
fits_pool <- res_pca$fits                # pooled models: Gesture, Learner_1, Learner_2, Sign
stopifnot("Gesture" %in% fits_pool[["all_PC1"]]$data$groupID)

# model data for one component, response renamed to `score` (z, as modelled)
get_comp_data <- function(k, fits) {
  resp <- as.character(formula(fits[[k]])$formula[[2]])   # e.g. "all_PC4_z"
  fits[[k]]$data %>% rename(score = all_of(resp)) %>% mutate(component = k)
}

natives  <- get_comp_data("all_PC4", fits_pool) %>% filter(groupID == "Sign") %>%
  distinct(participant) %>% pull() %>% as.character()
other_id <- setdiff(natives, model_id)
stopifnot(model_id %in% natives, length(other_id) == 1)

spk_label <- function(p) case_when(p == model_id ~ "native: MODEL",
                                   p == other_id ~ "native: other",
                                   TRUE ~ p)
who_of <- function(participant, groupID) case_when(
  participant == model_id ~ "native: MODEL",
  participant == other_id ~ "native: other",
  TRUE ~ as.character(groupID))

pal_who <- c(Gesture = "grey55", Learner_1 = "#7CAE00", Learner_2 = "#00BFC4",
             "native: MODEL" = "#8E44AD", "native: other" = "#D98CE0")
```

#### Per participant (pooled PCA)

```{r speaker-grid-pool, cache = FALSE, fig.width = 14, fig.height = 7}
comps_pool <- c("all_PC1", "all_PC2", "all_PC3", "all_PC4")
stopifnot(all(comps_pool %in% names(fits_pool)))

comp_lab_pool <- c(all_PC1 = "PC1 · vigour\n(lower = less vigorous)",
                   all_PC2 = "PC2 · handshape\n(lower = less open/extended hand)",
                   all_PC3 = "PC3 · tempo\n(lower = slower)",
                   all_PC4 = "PC4 · smoothness\n(lower = more fluent/smooth)")

spk_pool <- map_dfr(comps_pool, get_comp_data, fits = fits_pool) %>%
  mutate(participant = as.character(participant),
         who = who_of(participant, groupID)) %>%
  group_by(component, who, participant) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(score), se = sd(score) / sqrt(n()), n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(label = spk_label(participant), panel = comp_lab_pool[component])

ggplot(spk_pool, aes(mean, tidytext::reorder_within(label, mean, panel), colour = who)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, colour = "grey70") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = mean - 2 * se, xmax = mean + 2 * se), na.rm = TRUE) +
  tidytext::scale_y_reordered() +
  facet_wrap(~ panel, scales = "free", nrow = 1) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = pal_who, name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "PC score (z, pooled PCA)", y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "top")
```
We can see that in PC2 (handshape), most of the gesturers are in front of native signers as well as learners. In PC4 (smoothness) the separation is much more clear: two native signers are in front, followed by learners and at last, gesturers. However. note that the model native signer here is also far from the other native signer, so it may be that this subject drives the separation and more participants in this group are needed to specify the effect of smoothness (which may be expected less extreme). PC1 and PC3, in contrast, are much more mixed.

How much items overlap?

```{r}
# concept overlap between groups 
tok <- res_pca$d %>% select(groupID, participant, concept) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), as.character))

grp_sets <- list(
  Gesture  = "Gesture",
  Naive    = "Learner_1",
  Beginner = "Learner_2",
  Learners = c("Learner_1", "Learner_2"),
  Native   = "Sign",
  Signers  = c("Learner_1", "Learner_2", "Sign")
)

concepts_of <- function(s) tok %>% filter(groupID %in% grp_sets[[s]]) %>% distinct(concept) %>% pull()
tokens_in   <- function(s, cs) sum(tok$groupID %in% grp_sets[[s]] & tok$concept %in% cs)
tokens_all  <- function(s) sum(tok$groupID %in% grp_sets[[s]])

comparisons_ov <- tribble(
  ~comparison,                                ~a,         ~b,
  "Conventionalization (gesture vs native)",  "Gesture",  "Native",
  "Acquisition (learners vs native)",         "Learners", "Native",
  "All signers vs gesture",                   "Gesture",  "Signers",
  "Naive vs beginner",                        "Naive",    "Beginner",
  "Beginner vs native",                       "Beginner", "Native"
)

overlap <- comparisons_ov %>%
  mutate(
    shared     = map2(a, b, ~ intersect(concepts_of(.x), concepts_of(.y))),
    n_conc_a   = map_int(a, ~ length(concepts_of(.x))),
    n_conc_b   = map_int(b, ~ length(concepts_of(.x))),
    n_shared   = lengths(shared),
    tok_a      = map2_chr(a, shared, ~ sprintf("%d / %d", tokens_in(.x, .y), tokens_all(.x))),
    tok_b      = map2_chr(b, shared, ~ sprintf("%d / %d", tokens_in(.x, .y), tokens_all(.x)))
  ) %>%
  select(comparison, n_conc_a, n_conc_b, n_shared,
         `tokens a in shared` = tok_a, `tokens b in shared` = tok_b)

overlap

# shared concepts between every pair of the four groups 
g4 <- c("Gesture", "Learner_1", "Learner_2", "Sign")
cs <- map(set_names(g4), ~ tok %>% filter(groupID == .x) %>% distinct(concept) %>% pull())
overlap_matrix <- outer(g4, g4, Vectorize(\(i, j) length(intersect(cs[[i]], cs[[j]]))))
dimnames(overlap_matrix) <- list(g4, g4)
overlap_matrix                     # diagonal = number of concepts per group

length(Reduce(intersect, cs))      # concepts produced by all four groups

# per participant: concepts shared with the native signers
native_conc <- concepts_of("Native")
per_part_ov <- tok %>%
  distinct(groupID, participant, concept) %>%
  group_by(groupID, participant) %>%
  summarise(n_concepts      = n(),
            shared_w_native = sum(concept %in% native_conc),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(groupID, participant)

per_part_ov %>% print(n = Inf)


```


How are the results holding for overlapping items?
```{r}

within_concept <- function(k, grp_a, grp_b) {
  fit  <- res_pca$fits[[k]]
  resp <- all.vars(fit$formula$formula)[1]
  fit$data %>%
    mutate(side = case_when(groupID %in% grp_a ~ "a", groupID %in% grp_b ~ "b")) %>%
    filter(!is.na(side)) %>%
    group_by(concept, side) %>%
    summarise(m = mean(.data[[resp]]), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = side, values_from = m) %>%
    drop_na() %>%                                   # shared concepts only
    summarise(component     = k,
              n_concepts    = n(),
              median_diff   = median(b - a),        # b minus a, same coding as your contrasts
              share_neg     = mean(b - a < 0),
              share_pos     = mean(b - a > 0))
}

bind_rows(
  map_dfr(c("all_PC2", "all_PC3", "all_PC4"), within_concept,
          grp_a = c("Learner_1", "Learner_2"), grp_b = "Sign") %>% mutate(contrast = "acquisition"),
  map_dfr(c("all_PC2", "all_PC3", "all_PC4"), within_concept,
          grp_a = "Gesture", grp_b = "Sign") %>% mutate(contrast = "conventionalization")
)


```


PC4 (smoothness) effects hold for all overlapping concepts. PC2 (handshape) not so much: 60% for acquisition trajectory and 79% for conventionalization trajectory.

### Interpretation

```{r}

read_loadings_so <- function(domain) {
  path <- file.path("Datasets", sprintf("loadings_%s_signonly.csv", domain))  # adjust folder
  if (!file.exists(path)) return(NULL)
  read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(component   = paste0(domain, "_PC", PC),
           basis       = "signonly",
           sig_loading = CI_above_null_after)
}

loadings_sign <- map_dfr(c("all", "gross", "fine"), read_loadings_so)

# guard: silent empty joins
stopifnot(nrow(loadings_sign) > 0,
          all(c("variable", "obs_index", "loading_sign", "sig_loading") %in% names(loadings_sign)))

interpretation_sign <- coefs_sign %>%
  filter(credible) %>%
  select(basis, component, contrast, effect = estimate) %>%
  inner_join(loadings_sign, by = c("basis", "component")) %>%
  filter(sig_loading) %>%
  mutate(
    # split leading category ("gross__rwrist") from the measure ("speed_mean")
    has_cat  = str_detect(variable, "^[^_]+__[^_]+__"),
    category = if_else(has_cat, str_extract(variable, "^[^_]+__[^_]+"), NA_character_),
    measure  = if_else(has_cat, str_remove(variable, "^[^_]+__[^_]+__"), variable),
    # ∝ signed loading WITHIN a PC (index = loading² · eig²; eig constant per PC)
    loading_signed = loading_sign * sqrt(obs_index),
    # contrasts are (later - earlier), so this reads as "the more sign-like group has..."
    moves    = if_else(sign(effect) == sign(loading_sign), "↑ more", "↓ less")
  ) %>%
    select(basis, contrast, component, effect, category, measure, moves,
         loading_signed, obs_index, share, cum_frac, within_50pct, is_anchor, variable) %>%
  arrange(basis, contrast, component, category, desc(obs_index))

interpretation_sign
```

```{r}
pairs <- tribble(

  emmeans(fits_pool[[k]], ~ groupID, re_formula = NA) %>%
    gather_emmeans_draws() %>% median_qi(.value) %>%

# raw speaker means, computed from the model data of each PC

  fit  <- fits_pool[[k]]
  resp <- all.vars(fit$formula$formula)[1]        
  fit$data %>%

# common range for all panels
lims <- range(c(spk_long$mean, grp_long$.lower, grp_long$.upper), na.rm = TRUE)
lims <- c(floor(lims[1] * 2) / 2, ceiling(lims[2] * 2) / 2)

# one panel
pair_plot <- function(kx, ky) {
  to_xy <- function(d) d %>%
    filter(component %in% c(kx, ky)) %>%
    mutate(ax = if_else(component == kx, "x", "y")) %>%
    select(-component)

  g <- to_xy(grp_long) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = ax, values_from = c(.value, .lower, .upper))

  s <- to_xy(spk_long) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = ax, values_from = mean)

  a <- s %>%
    filter(who %in% c("Learner_1", "Learner_2")) %>%
    pivot_wider(id_cols = participant, names_from = who, values_from = c(x, y)) %>%
    drop_na()

  ggplot() +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey85") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey85") +
    geom_point(data = s, aes(x, y, colour = who), alpha = .35, size = 1.8) +
    geom_segment(data = a,
                 aes(x = x_Learner_1, y = y_Learner_1, xend = x_Learner_2, yend = y_Learner_2),
                 arrow = arrow(length = unit(4, "pt")), colour = "grey45", linewidth = .35) +
    geom_errorbar(data = g, width = 0, linewidth = .8,
                  aes(x = .value_x, ymin = .lower_y, ymax = .upper_y, colour = groupID)) +
    geom_errorbarh(data = g, height = 0, linewidth = .8,
                   aes(y = .value_y, xmin = .lower_x, xmax = .upper_x, colour = groupID)) +
    geom_point(data = g, size = 3.5, shape = 21, fill = "white", stroke = 1.3,
               aes(.value_x, .value_y, colour = groupID)) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = grp_cols, name = NULL) +
    coord_equal(xlim = lims, ylim = lims) +
    labs(x = ax_lab(kx), y = ax_lab(ky)) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10))
}
```

```{r table-setup, cache = FALSE}
        "+/− = sign of the loading (+: higher feature value → higher score); % = share of the component's index loading."),
  paste("**Models.** One Bayesian model per component: score_z ~ 0 + group + (1 | participant) + (1 | concept), Gaussian;",
        "priors Normal(0, 1) on group means, Exponential(1) on SDs and σ; 4 chains × 8,000 iterations (4,000 warm-up),",
        "adapt_delta = 0.95. Contrasts extracted with emmeans (population level) as more sign-like minus less sign-like group,",
        "in SD units of the respective PCA's scores: negative = the more sign-like group scores lower.",
        "Conventionalization = native − gesture; acquisition = native − mean(naive, beginner);",
        "all signers vs gesture = mean(naive, beginner, native) − gesture.",
        "**Bold** = 95% CrI excludes 0; pd = probability of direction.",
        "Scores are z-scaled within each PCA, so magnitudes are not comparable across blocks.",
        "Contrasts involving gesturers are not estimable in sign-only PCAs and are omitted there."),
  "**Diagnostics.** Max R̂ / min bulk ESS / number of divergent transitions per model."
)

note_domain <- paste("**Domains.** Gross = torso, arm, wrist and head features; fine = finger and hand(shape) features;",
                     "all = both sets together. Each domain has its own PCA and its own models.")

# quick check: every listed contrast must exist in coefs_all
coefs_all %>% count(basis, contrast) %>% print(n = Inf)
missing <- setdiff(contr_all, unique(coefs_all$contrast))
if (length(missing)) warning("Not in coefs_all: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "),
                             " -> re-extract coefs / coefs_sign with the renamed comparisons")

# ===================================================================
# 1. Detailed table: one block per (basis, domain)
# ===================================================================
dim_table <- function(spec, title, file, notes_extra = NULL) {
  # spec: tibble(basis, domain, block); one row group per spec row, in that order
  spec <- spec %>%
    mutate(block = paste0(block, " (", map2_chr(basis, domain, n_info), ")"))
  keys <- select(spec, basis, domain)

  var_tab <- var_all %>%
    semi_join(keys, by = c("basis", "domain")) %>%
    transmute(basis, domain, component = paste0(domain, "_PC", PC),
              variance = sprintf("%.1f%%<br>[%.1f, %.1f]<br><small>cum. %.0f%%</small>",
                                 100 * var_exp, 100 * var_low, 100 * var_high, 100 * cum_var))

  # rows = every modeled component of every PCA (not only those in the variance file)
  rows <- bind_rows(
    coefs_all %>% semi_join(keys, by = c("basis", "domain")) %>% distinct(basis, domain, component),
    select(var_tab, basis, domain, component)
  ) %>% distinct()

  missing_var <- anti_join(keys, distinct(var_tab, basis, domain), by = c("basis", "domain"))
  if (nrow(missing_var) > 0)
    warning("No variance rows for: ", paste(missing_var$basis, missing_var$domain, sep = "/", collapse = ", "),
            ". Check the `domain` values in pca_variance_explained.csv: ",
            paste(unique(var_all$domain), collapse = ", "))

  feat_tab <- pmap_dfr(keys, read_loadings) %>%
    add_count(basis, component, name = "n_sig") %>%
    filter(within_50pct) %>%
    arrange(basis, component, desc(share)) %>%
    group_by(basis, component, n_sig) %>%
    summarise(n_top = n(),
              features = paste0(if_else(loading_sign > 0, "&#43;", "−"), " ", pretty_feat(variable),
                                " (", round(100 * share), "%)", collapse = "<br>"),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(features = paste0(features, "<br><small><i>", n_top, " of ", n_sig,
                             " significant features</i></small>")) %>%
    select(basis, component, features)

  con_tab <- coefs_all %>%
    semi_join(keys, by = c("basis", "domain")) %>%
    mutate(cell = sprintf("%s%.2f<br>[%.2f, %.2f]%s<br><small>pd = %.3f</small>",
                          if_else(credible, "<b>", ""), estimate, .lower, .upper,
                          if_else(credible, "</b>", ""), pd)) %>%
    select(basis, component, contrast, cell) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = contrast, values_from = cell)

  conv_tab <- conv_all %>%
    semi_join(keys, by = c("basis", "domain")) %>%
    transmute(basis, component,
              diag = sprintf("%.3f<br>%.0f<br>%d", max_rhat, min_ess_bulk, as.integer(n_divergent)))

  tab <- rows %>%
    left_join(select(var_tab, -domain), by = c("basis", "component")) %>%
    left_join(pc_labels, by = c("basis", "component")) %>%
    left_join(feat_tab,  by = c("basis", "component")) %>%
    left_join(con_tab,   by = c("basis", "component")) %>%
    left_join(conv_tab,  by = c("basis", "component")) %>%
    left_join(select(spec, basis, domain, block), by = c("basis", "domain")) %>%
    mutate(Dim = dim_of(component), block = factor(block, levels = spec$block)) %>%
    arrange(block, parse_number(Dim))

  # keep only contrasts that exist in at least one block of this table
  contr <- contr_all[contr_all %in% names(tab)]
  contr <- contr[map_lgl(contr, ~ any(!is.na(tab[[.x]])))]

  gt_tab <- tab %>%
    select(block, Dim, label, variance, features, all_of(contr), diag) %>%
    gt(groupname_col = "block") %>%
    tab_header(title = title) %>%
    cols_label(.list = c(list(Dim = "Dim.", label = "Interpretation",
                              variance = html("Variance<br>explained"),
                              features = html("Features up to 50%<br>of index loading"),
                              diag     = html("R̂ / ESS /<br>div.")),
                         contr_lab[contr])) %>%
    tab_spanner("Dimension", columns = c(Dim, label, variance, features)) %>%
    tab_spanner("Group comparisons: estimate [95% CrI], SD units", columns = all_of(contr)) %>%
    fmt_markdown(columns = c(variance, features, all_of(contr), diag)) %>%
    sub_missing(missing_text = "—") %>%
    cols_width(features ~ px(260), label ~ px(140)) %>%
    tab_style(style = cell_text(size = px(11)), locations = cells_body()) %>%
    tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"), locations = cells_row_groups())

  for (n in c(notes_extra, notes_base)) gt_tab <- tab_source_note(gt_tab, md(n))
  gtsave(gt_tab, file)
  gt_tab
}

# ===================================================================
# 2. Compact summary: which domain × dimension carries which trajectory
# ===================================================================
traj_map <- function(bases, title, file) {
  present <- coefs_all %>%
    filter(basis %in% bases) %>%
    distinct(basis, domain, contrast)

  cred <- coefs_all %>%
    filter(basis %in% bases, credible) %>%
    left_join(pc_labels, by = c("basis", "component")) %>%
    mutate(cell = sprintf("%s %+.2f%s", dim_of(component), estimate,
                          if_else(is.na(label), "", paste0(" <small>", label, "</small>")))) %>%
    group_by(basis, domain, contrast) %>%
    summarise(cell = paste(cell, collapse = "<br>"), .groups = "drop")

  tab <- present %>%
    left_join(cred, by = c("basis", "domain", "contrast")) %>%
    mutate(cell = coalesce(cell, "—")) %>%                         # estimable, nothing credible
    pivot_wider(names_from = contrast, values_from = cell) %>%    # NA = not estimable
    left_join(select(basis_info, basis, title), by = "basis") %>%
    mutate(block  = factor(title, levels = basis_info$title[basis_info$basis %in% bases]),
           domain = factor(domain, levels = dom_levels, labels = dom_lab[dom_levels])) %>%
    arrange(block, domain)

  contr <- contr_all[contr_all %in% names(tab)]

  gt_tab <- tab %>%
    select(block, domain, all_of(contr)) %>%
    gt(groupname_col = "block") %>%
    tab_header(title = title) %>%
    cols_label(.list = c(list(domain = "Domain"), contr_lab[contr])) %>%
    fmt_markdown(columns = all_of(contr)) %>%
    sub_missing(missing_text = "n/a") %>%
    tab_style(style = cell_text(size = px(11)), locations = cells_body()) %>%
    tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"), locations = cells_row_groups()) %>%
    tab_source_note(md(paste(
      "Cells list the dimensions whose 95% CrI for that contrast excludes 0, with the posterior mean (SD units).",
      "— = estimable but no credible difference; n/a = contrast not estimable in that PCA (no gesturers).",
      "Dimension numbers refer to each domain's own PCA; see the detailed tables for intervals and loadings.")))

  gtsave(gt_tab, file)
  gt_tab
}
```

```{r}
# model based group means

  emmeans(fits_pool[[k]], ~ groupID, re_formula = NA) %>%

}) %>%

# L1-L2 shift
```

### Table 4 - all together
```{r table-replication, cache = FALSE}
ref_key <- tibble(basis = "pca", domain = "all")

rep_targets <- tribble(
  ~col,                 ~basis,     ~domain, ~col_lab,
  "rep_pca_gross",      "pca",      "gross", "Gross",
  "rep_pca_fine",       "pca",      "fine",  "Fine",
  "rep_signonly_all",   "signonly", "all",   "All",
  "rep_signonly_gross", "signonly", "gross", "Gross",
  "rep_signonly_fine",  "signonly", "fine",  "Fine"
)

# all six pcas
load_all <- pmap_dfr(
  bind_rows(ref_key, select(rep_targets, basis, domain)),
  function(basis, domain)
    read_loadings(basis, domain) %>%
      mutate(basis = .env$basis, domain = .env$domain)
) %>%
  mutate(feat_domain = str_extract(variable, "^[a-z]+"),   # "gross" / "fine"
         sgn         = sign(loading_sign))

l50     <- filter(load_all, within_50pct)
ref_l50 <- semi_join(l50, ref_key, by = c("basis", "domain"))

ref_comps <- coefs_all %>%
  semi_join(ref_key, by = c("basis", "domain")) %>%
  distinct(component) %>% pull(component)
ref_comps <- ref_comps[order(parse_number(dim_of(ref_comps)))]

# match each pooled-all component to a component in each other PCA 
match_comp <- function(ref_comp, t_basis, t_domain) {
  ref <- filter(ref_l50, component == ref_comp)
  if (t_domain != "all") ref <- filter(ref, feat_domain == t_domain)
  k <- nrow(ref)
  if (k == 0) return(tibble(status = "no_domain_features"))

  cand <- l50 %>%
    filter(basis == t_basis, domain == t_domain) %>%
    inner_join(select(ref, variable, sgn_ref = sgn), by = "variable") %>%
    group_by(component) %>%
    summarise(agree = sum(sgn == sgn_ref), flip = sum(sgn == -sgn_ref), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(n_shared = pmax(agree, flip), flipped = flip > agree) %>%
    filter(n_shared > k / 2) %>%
    arrange(desc(n_shared))

  if (nrow(cand) == 0) return(tibble(status = "no_match", k = k))
  slice(cand, 1) %>%
    transmute(status = "match", match_comp = component, n_shared, k, flipped)
}

rep_matches <- expand_grid(ref_comp = ref_comps, rep_targets) %>%
  mutate(res = pmap(list(ref_comp, basis, domain), match_comp)) %>%
  unnest(res)

rep_matches %>%                                   # sanity check of the mapping
  select(ref_comp, basis, domain, status, match_comp, n_shared, k, flipped) %>%
  print(n = Inf)

# check / cross per contrast
rep_symbol <- function(est_ref, rel_ref, est, rel) {
  case_when(
    is.na(est)                                 ~ "–",
    rel_ref & rel & sign(est) == sign(est_ref) ~ "<span style='color:#1b7a3a'>✓</span>",
    rel_ref                                    ~ "<span style='color:#b3261e'>✗</span>",
    rel                                        ~ "<span style='color:#1f5fa8'>&#43;</span>",
    TRUE                                       ~ "·"
  )
}

ref_con <- coefs_all %>%
  semi_join(ref_key, by = c("basis", "domain")) %>%
  select(ref_comp = component, contrast, est_ref = estimate, rel_ref = credible)

rep_cells <- rep_matches %>%
  filter(status == "match") %>%
  expand_grid(contrast = contr_all) %>%
  left_join(coefs_all %>%
              select(basis, domain, match_comp = component, contrast, estimate, rel = credible),
            by = c("basis", "domain", "match_comp", "contrast")) %>%
  left_join(ref_con, by = c("ref_comp", "contrast")) %>%
  mutate(estimate = if_else(flipped, -estimate, estimate),
         rel_ref  = coalesce(rel_ref, FALSE),
         contrast = factor(contrast, levels = contr_all),
         sym      = rep_symbol(est_ref, rel_ref, estimate, rel)) %>%
  arrange(ref_comp, col, contrast) %>%
  group_by(ref_comp, col, match_comp, n_shared, k, flipped) %>%
  summarise(syms = paste(sym, collapse = " "), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(cell = sprintf(
    "%s%s <small>(%d/%d)</small><br><span style='font-family:monospace'>%s</span>",
    dim_of(match_comp), if_else(flipped, " (−)", ""), n_shared, k, syms)) %>%
  select(ref_comp, col, cell) %>%
  bind_rows(rep_matches %>%
              filter(status != "match") %>%
              transmute(ref_comp, col,
                        cell = if_else(status == "no_domain_features",
                                       "<span style='color:#999'>n/a</span>", "—"))) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = col, values_from = cell) %>%
  rename(component = ref_comp)

# pooled-all columns
ref_var <- var_all %>%
  semi_join(ref_key, by = c("basis", "domain")) %>%
  transmute(component = paste0(domain, "_PC", PC),
            variance  = sprintf("%.1f%%<br>[%.1f, %.1f]<br><small>cum. %.0f%%</small>",
                                100 * var_exp, 100 * var_low, 100 * var_high, 100 * cum_var))

ref_feat <- semi_join(load_all, ref_key, by = c("basis", "domain")) %>%
  add_count(component, name = "n_sig") %>%
  filter(within_50pct) %>%
  arrange(component, desc(share)) %>%
  group_by(component, n_sig) %>%
  summarise(n_top = n(),
            features = paste0(if_else(loading_sign > 0, "&#43;", "−"), " ", pretty_feat(variable),
                              " (", round(100 * share), "%)", collapse = "<br>"),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  transmute(component,
            features = paste0(features, "<br><small><i>", n_top, " of ", n_sig,
                              " significant features</i></small>"))

ref_con_tab <- coefs_all %>%
  semi_join(ref_key, by = c("basis", "domain")) %>%
  mutate(cell = sprintf("%s%.2f<br>[%.2f, %.2f]%s<br><small>pd = %.3f</small>",
                        if_else(credible, "<b>", ""), estimate, .lower, .upper,
                        if_else(credible, "</b>", ""), pd)) %>%
  select(component, contrast, cell) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = contrast, values_from = cell)

ref_diag <- conv_all %>%
  semi_join(ref_key, by = c("basis", "domain")) %>%
  transmute(component,
            diag = sprintf("%.3f<br>%.0f<br>%d", max_rhat, min_ess_bulk, as.integer(n_divergent)))

rep_tab <- tibble(component = ref_comps) %>%
  left_join(filter(pc_labels, basis == "pca") %>% select(component, label), by = "component") %>%
  left_join(ref_var,     by = "component") %>%
  left_join(ref_feat,    by = "component") %>%
  left_join(ref_con_tab, by = "component") %>%
  left_join(rep_cells,   by = "component") %>%
  left_join(ref_diag,    by = "component") %>%
  mutate(Dim   = dim_of(component),
         block = paste0("Pooled PCA on all features (", n_info("pca", "all"), ")"))

contr_rep <- contr_all[contr_all %in% names(rep_tab)]

# gt table
gt_rep <- rep_tab %>%
  select(block, Dim, label, variance, features, all_of(contr_rep),
         all_of(rep_targets$col), diag) %>%
  gt(groupname_col = "block") %>%
  tab_header(title = "Pooled-all kinematic dimensions and their replication across domains and samples") %>%
  cols_label(.list = c(list(Dim = "Dim.", label = "Interpretation",
                            variance = html("Variance<br>explained"),
                            features = html("Features up to 50%<br>of index loading"),
                            diag     = html("R̂ / ESS /<br>div.")),
                       contr_lab[contr_rep],
                       setNames(as.list(rep_targets$col_lab), rep_targets$col))) %>%
  tab_spanner("Dimension", columns = c(Dim, label, variance, features)) %>%
  tab_spanner("Group comparisons: estimate [95% CrI], SD units", columns = all_of(contr_rep)) %>%
  tab_spanner("Replication: pooled",    columns = c(rep_pca_gross, rep_pca_fine)) %>%
  tab_spanner("Replication: sign-only", columns = c(rep_signonly_all, rep_signonly_gross, rep_signonly_fine)) %>%
  fmt_markdown(columns = c(variance, features, all_of(contr_rep), all_of(rep_targets$col), diag)) %>%
  sub_missing(missing_text = "—") %>%
  cols_width(features ~ px(260), label ~ px(140), starts_with("rep_") ~ px(95)) %>%
  tab_style(style = cell_text(size = px(11)), locations = cells_body()) %>%
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"), locations = cells_row_groups())

note_rep <- paste(
  "**Replication.** For each additional PCA, the corresponding component is the one containing, with consistent sign,",
  "the majority of the pooled-all dimension’s features up to 50% of index loading that belong to that domain",
  "(shared/total in brackets; for mixed dimensions the gross and fine parts are matched separately;",
  "(−) = sign-reflected component, estimates flipped accordingly).",
  "Symbols follow the contrast columns (conventionalization · gesture–native · naive–beginner · beginner–native · learner–native):",
  "✓ = credible in pooled-all and replicated in the same direction; ✗ = credible in pooled-all, not replicated;",
  "+ = credible only in this PCA; · = credible in neither; – = not estimable (no gesturers in the sign-only sample).",
  "— = no corresponding component; n/a = the domain contains none of the dimension’s features.",
  "See Tables 1–3 for the estimates of the matched components.")

for (n in c(note_rep, note_domain, notes_base)) gt_rep <- tab_source_note(gt_rep, md(n))

gtsave(gt_rep, "results/table5_replication.html")
gt_rep
```
